subject: 龙山三天大法师窟 · 主尊局部
author: Halazhang
source_note: Halazhang于2014年实拍，现场牌明确“三天大法师窟（唐窟）”。仅绘中央坐像，底座被牌遮挡部分省略，不凭空复原。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One fine-line heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER only: delicate sparse slightly organic contours and generous blank white planes. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY only. PURE BLACK INK outlines on PURE WHITE, all interiors white. No gray, no shading, no dark openings, no hatching, no textures, no color, no text, no border. Preserve the real monument, not the Buddha in the style master. Subject: the CENTRAL seated Taoist deity of the Three Heavenly Masters grotto (三天大法师窟) at Longshan, Taiyuan, in photo 2. Draw ONLY the central seated figure, from topknot to folded knees. Preserve the actual small topknot, weathered face, broad crossed collar, tied rectangular robe front, draped bent arms and broad folded legs. Keep the eroded facial features understated: no invented smiling face or Buddhist ushnisha. OMIT both standing attendants, all background cave rock, and the modern sign, and omit the plinth below the knees that the sign obscures. One faint circular halo arc is enough. This is explicitly a selected statue study, not reconstruction of the complete grotto. Portrait 1024x1536, centered with the entire selected statue occupying 75% of height, much white space. About a dozen selective robe contours, no granular stone detail.

site_recommendation.sub: 三天大法师窟 · 主尊
site_recommendation.era: 唐代龛像 · 后有元代扩凿
site_recommendation.yearNote: 三天大法师龛依现场标识及晋源文旅资料采用唐代断代，800仅约略定位；石窟群元代主体另述。
site_recommendation.lede: 龙山以道教石窟著称，窟内高髻、宽袍的造像与佛教大像自有不同。本图选早期三天大法师窟的中央坐像，保留面部风化后的含蓄轮廓。
facts: 石窟群中，三天大法师龛与玄真龛依地方文旅资料属唐代，其他主体多为元代营造。
本图只画三天大法师窟主尊，从发髻至盘坐双膝，不代表完整三尊组合。
元代扩凿与全真道有关；图版颜色依据所绘唐代龛像，不以整组国保断代替代单体年代。
